_classes.name: designation_no_actor gate drops real powers and duties written as list items of a body's enumerated powers ('To appoint...', 'Report to...')
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json where rule=='designation_no_actor' and quote matches ^(To\s+[a-z]+|Report|Establish|Adopt|Provide|Maintain|Prepare|Submit|Develop|Make|Issue|Appoint|...|Perform)\b (imperative verb start; noun-start report-content items excluded)

_classes.name: model resolved the actor (Nassau county, named partnership) but stored agency is Unspecified (passive-subject and named-public-body resolver gap)
bogus county agency_unit built from a stray word ('Entity County', 'Empower County')
_classes.rule: agency_group=='Counties' and agency_unit, after stripping 'County of '/' County', does not start with one of the 62 NY county names

_classes.name: list items under a 'shall:' lead-in stored as power although kind_rule and kind_model both say duty (lead-in kind taken from the preceding 'may adopt' sentence)
reprinted duty or power whose only braced words are pronoun or title substitutions stored as a record
_classes.rule: locate quote in packet text with [deleted] removed; braced segments inside the quoted span are all in {'or her','or she','or his','his or her','he or she','the superintendent','the commissioner'}

_classes.name: tax-benefit availability window (421-a) stored as a NYC duty
_classes.rule: quote matches (?i)benefits of this (sub)?(paragraph|section|subdivision|title) shall be available|shall be (eligible|entitled) (for|to) (the )?(benefits|exemption)

_classes.name: follow-on design duty for a pilot given on_effective_date while the pilot itself has a 180-day offset
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' and quote matches ^(Such|The|Each) (pilot|program|project|study|plan|report)s?\b and another record of the same matter_id has deadline_kind days_after_effective/enactment

_classes.name: extension-only laws: braced sunset dates in earlier chapters' effective sections not stored (rent-law extenders, sunset deletion)
_classes.rule: none mechanical: misses are absent records
